description: Shell script for testing CRLF message handling in git commit and tag messages, including creating references, testing output formats, and verifying message contents with CRLF line endings.

methods.name: create_crlf_ref
methods.description: Creates a git reference with a message containing CRLF line endings, and sets up branch and tag references.

methods.name: create_crlf_refs
methods.description: Creates multiple references with CRLF messages for testing.

methods.name: test_crlf_subject_body_and_contents
methods.description: Runs tests to verify that git commands correctly handle commit and tag messages with CRLF line endings.
